title: A Gentle Return to Self

content:
The first twenty years of my life
were a small, quiet circle —
just me,
my studies,
story books,
drawings,
and a few familiar faces from the neighbourhood.
I lived mostly within myself…
yet somewhere deep inside,
there was a silent yearning —
for a sibling,
for that unseen bond I often watched in others.
But I remained reserved,
holding my world gently within.

The next twenty years unfolded differently.
Through Ram,
life gifted me a circle of relationships —
warm, close, and meaningful.
I embraced them as my own.
Happiness often outweighed
the small differences that came along,
and in those moments,
life quietly taught me
its most valuable lessons.

In my forties,
I began to see the world
with a clearer, softer understanding.
The pride I once held
in being surrounded by so much affection
slowly dissolved…
There were moments of guilt too —
of having unknowingly placed my parents
in the second space of my heart.
Yet, their love remained unchanged,
steady and unconditional,
as it always had been.

As life moved through its phases,
I understood…
we meet many people along the way.
Some walk beside us for long,
some drift away,
and some return again
when paths unexpectedly cross.

And now…
with a heart that seeks only the positive,
I find myself returning to my square one —
but this time,
without loneliness,
without longing.
There is only quiet contentment
in my small, simple world.

A deeper connection
with the universe…
and a gentle awareness
of the beauty hidden
in the smallest gestures.

Life is beautiful.
